Radboudumc
Department of Radiology
Date: 05 Dec 2024
Exam: Multiparametric MRI prostate
Clinical indication: PSA 8.1 ng/mL, prior biopsy Gleason 3+4. Evaluate for focal lesion and local staging.
FINDINGS: Prostate volume 39.35 mL. Peripheral zone shows a focal area in the left apex with mildly restricted diffusion on DWI/ADC and subtle T2 hypointensity. Dynamic contrast enhancement is equivocal. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is identified. No suspicious lymphadenopathy.
IMPRESSION: PI-RADS 3 lesion, left apex, ~9 mm. PSA density 0.206 ng/mL/mL. Clinical T stage cT2. csPCa predicted probability 0.81509304.

previous_notes.author: Dr. R. van den Berg (GP)
previous_notes.text: Patient presented with elevated PSA of 6.1 ng/mL. Digital rectal examination was unremarkable at that time. Transrectal ultrasound-guided biopsy was performed and histology returned Gleason 3+4, ISUP grade group 2. Referral to urology was initiated for further management discussion.

pathology_report:
Biopsy 1 (25 Jan 2023): Histological examination reveals acinar adenocarcinoma. The Gleason score is 3+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 2. Perineural invasion is present. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone, apex left. No cribriform or intraductal patterns identified.

Summary: The single available biopsy timepoint demonstrates ISUP grade group 2 disease with perineural invasion in the left apex.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 3.
